# Premium Invitation

> Premium 3D interactive invitation websites for weddings, engagements, birthdays, and all Indian celebrations. Custom-designed digital invitations with 3D effects, RSVP, photo gallery, live countdown, and bilingual Hindi/English support. Based in India, serving clients worldwide. Website: https://premiuminvitation.com

## Services & Pricing

- [Pricing Plans](https://premiuminvitation.com/pricing): Three tiers — Essential (INR 2,999), Premium (INR 5,999), Grand (INR 9,999). Every invitation is custom-designed with 3D animations, countdown, dark/light themes, and WhatsApp sharing. Premium adds RSVP, gallery, and bilingual support. Grand adds love story, video, multi-event schedule, and QR code.

## Live Demos

- [Engagement Invitation Demo](https://premiuminvitation.com/example-engagement): Sacred Ganesh Vandana opening, 3D ring ceremony effects, live countdown, venue map, bilingual English & Hindi
- [Wedding Invitation Demo](https://premiuminvitation.com/example-wedding): Midnight romance theme with starfield, jaimala animation, photo gallery, 8 sections, one-tap RSVP, bilingual
- [Birthday Invitation Demo](https://premiuminvitation.com/example-birthday): 3D birthday cake with flickering candles, confetti burst, interactive balloon, RSVP
- [Valentine Invitation Demo](https://premiuminvitation.com/example-valentine): Heart particles, self-typing love letter, photo memories, dual countdowns, 7 sections

## Occasions We Serve

- [All Occasions](https://premiuminvitation.com/occasions): Wedding, engagement, roka ceremony, haldi, mehndi, sangeet, reception, birthday, baby shower, naming ceremony, anniversary, Valentine's Day, retirement, housewarming, corporate events, and more

## How to Order

1. Message us on WhatsApp (+91 98187 88738) with your event details (names, date, venue, photos)
2. We design your custom 3D invitation — most delivered within 24 hours
3. You receive a unique URL to share with guests — works on every phone, tablet, and computer. No app downloads needed.

## Key Features

- Real-time 3D animations and particle effects (Three.js)
- One-tap RSVP — no downloads, no sign-ups for guests
- Live countdown timer to your event
- Photo gallery with fullscreen previews
- Bilingual support (Hindi & English)
- Dark and light theme toggle
- Custom QR code for physical invitation cards
- Works on all devices and browsers
